jobs.description:
What does a reachtruckchauffeur do here? You keep goods flowing smoothly. As a reachtruckchauffeur, you move products, load and unload trucks, and prepare orders for shipping.

It’s a bit like being a traffic controller—but inside a warehouse. You’ll also check quality and keep things tidy and safe.

Are you the right reachtruckchauffeur? You have experience, a valid certificate, and feel confident on a reach truck.

As a reachtruckchauffeur, you’re flexible with shifts and communicate in English or Dutch.

You work accurately, safely, and like being part of a team.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker and terminal Tractor Driver
jobs.description:
This is a varied job where you combine warehouse work with driving a terminal tractor (Terberg).

Your tasks:

 
• Picking orders with a hand scanner
 
• Loading and unloading trucks
 
• Working with an electric pallet truck (BT)
 
• Moving trailers safely around the site with a Terberg vehicle
 
• Checking goods in the warehouse management system (WMS)
 
• Keeping your workplace clean and safe

Some days you may spend more time in the warehouse, while at other times you will mainly move trailers on site.

 
• Experience in warehouse operations
 
• Comfortable working with scanners and digital systems
 
• Experience driving a Terberg / terminal tractor or similar vehicle
 
• Experience with an electric pallet truck
 
• Good knowledge of English or Dutch
 
• Team player with a safety-first mindset
 
• Valid CE driving licence or Terminal Tractor (Terberg) certificate

jobs.occupation: Senior Test Manager - AI-Assisted Testing - Brussels
jobs.description:
Location: Brussels, BelgiumDuration: 12 months, renewableWorking arrangement: Hybrid - 2 days/week on-site after onboarding. 
About the company
Our client is a leading Belgian company operating in the financial services sector, offering a wide range of solutions and services.As part of its ongoing digital transformation, the company is looking for a Senior Test Manager to lead and coordinate testing activities within its Application team. 
About the role
You will coordinate testing activities and guide a team of Test Analysts, ensuring quality, efficiency and successful project delivery.Your main responsibilities will include: 

• Coordinating testing activities across different projects
• Defining and overseeing test strategies, plans and execution.
• Working closely with Business Analysts, IT teams and other stakeholders.
• Managing priorities, resources, deadlines and testing risks.
• Following up on test execution, defects and delivery progress.
• Remaining hands-on and supporting the team beyond reporting and coordination.
• Promoting the use of AI to improve test planning, test case generation and overall testing efficiency.
• Guiding team members in the effective use of AI and sharing your expertise across the team.
The ideal candidate
• Proven experience as a Senior Test Manager or in a similar role.
• Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, tools and best practices.
• Mandatory: Proven hands-on experience using AI in real testing activities and projects.
• Good command of English and at least one Belgian national language (French or Dutch); trilingualism is a strong advantage.
• Experience working with cross-functional teams.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong delivery mindset and ability to manage challenging deadlines.
• Hands-on approach, with the ability to get involved in operational testing activities.
• Ability to translate AI knowledge into practical testing approaches and coach team members.
• ISTQB certification (Foundation Level or higher) is mandatory/
Experience in test automation is a plus, but practical AI experience is the priority.

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

Your responsibilities include operating equipment such as cooking kettles, filling machines, mixers, and combi steam ovens. You also prepare dishes and food components in accordance with our quality, hygiene, and safety standards.

 

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:

• Taking over the duties of kitchen staff in their absence.

• Carrying out the necessary quality checks on raw materials and preparing them for processing when required. Depending on the workload, you work together with kitchen staff, providing them with clear instructions and guidance to ensure that their tasks are carried out correctly.

• Independently following and executing recipes in accordance with quality standards and IFS requirements.

• Ensuring that industrial equipment is properly cleaned after and between each production run, in accordance with hygiene regulations.

• Preparing spice blends according to the recipes when the Goods Receiving employee is absent.

• Correctly preparing frozen ingredients and recipe components according to the production order.

• Labelling semi-finished products and recording their use in our computer system.

• Recording cooling temperatures.

Requirements:

• You have a very good command of Dutch (speaking, reading, writing, and understanding). A good knowledge of English and/or French is an advantage.

• You are comfortable with basic calculations, reading weights, and using weighing scales.

• You have completed training in a culinary field (institutional catering, chef, catering assistant, or butcher) or have equivalent experience.

• You are familiar with food safety regulations.

• You are able to operate a manual pallet truck.

• You are flexible and enjoy the challenge of switching between different departments.

• You can work well under pressure. Things can get quite busy at Marblo! 

• You maintain a neat and well-groomed appearance. For hygiene and safety reasons, gel nails, excessive make-up, visible piercings, etc., are not permitted in our production areas.

Are you an experienced Java Developer looking for challenging enterprise projects where you can make a real impact?

At Inetum Belgium, we are looking for a Senior Java Developer with strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, Cloud technologies (Azure/AWS), and modern software engineering practices.

You will work on large-scale digital transformation projects, helping leading organizations design, develop and maintain scalable enterprise applications. Together with architects, analysts, developers and business stakeholders, you will contribute to innovative solutions that deliver real business value.

Forget about conventional communication styles, the main language we speak is Java. If you are passionate about backend development, cloud-native architectures, software craftsmanship and continuous learning, you might be the next Java expert Inetum Belgium is looking for. 

As a Medior - Senior Java Developer, you will:

• Develop, maintain and improve enterprise-grade Java applications.
• Design and implement scalable backend solutions using Java and the Spring ecosystem.
• Build and maintain RESTful APIs and integration services.
• Contribute to microservices and event-driven architectures.
• Collaborate with architects, analysts and development teams on complex cross-project initiatives.
• Participate actively in Agile and Scrum ceremonies.
• Identify opportunities for technical improvements and software optimization.
• Take ownership of software quality through unit testing, integration testing and code reviews.
• Ensure the delivery of well-designed, maintainable, testable and efficient code.
• Support and coach junior developers when needed.
• Contribute to development standards, best practices and technical documentation.

Required

• Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Java Development, with expertise in backend and/or full stack application development.
• Proven experience designing, developing and maintaining enterprise-scale software solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience working in Agile development environments.
• Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Technical Skills & Experience

• Java (Java 8/11/17+)
• Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data & Spring Security
• REST APIs, SOAP, XML & JSON Integrations
• Microservices & Event-Driven Architectures
• Hibernate & JPA
• Maven & Gradle
• Azure and/or AWS
• Enterprise Application Servers (JBoss, WildFly, WebSphere, Oracle Middleware)
• Tomcat and similar runtimes
• CI/CD & DevOps Practices
• Automated Testing & Software Quality
• Agile & Scrum Methodologies
• AI-Assisted Development (GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot)
• Fluent English
• Professional working proficiency in Dutch and/or French

Do you have experience working with fabrics and know how to identify different pattern pieces? For a garment manufacturing company in the Tielt region, we are looking for someone to prepare fabrics for the cutting process and correctly sort the cut pattern pieces.

• You set up the machine and monitor the automatic unrolling and layering of the fabric.

• You take into account the fabric direction, warp and weft when preparing the materials

• You identify weaving defects and other irregularities and position the fabric in such a way that defective sections do not end up in the finished garments

• You check that the fabrics are correctly prepared and ready for the cutting machine.

• You collect the cut pieces and sort them according to the correct pattern.

• You group components such as sleeves, collars, front panels and back panels so they can be processed together in the next production stage.

• You follow the production schedule and ensure that the work progresses smoothly and efficiently.

 

• You have knowledge of fabrics and textiles, preferably gained through experience in a garment workshop or textile company.

• You can identify different garment components and pattern pieces.

• You can recognise fabric defects and know how to take them into account when laying out the fabric.

• You work accurately while maintaining a good production pace.

• You can count correctly and distinguish between colours, sizes and quantities.

• You have a sufficient understanding of Dutch to correctly interpret work instructions, numbers and labels. Knowledge of English is also an advantage.

• You are physically fit for the job and can work both independently and as part of a team.

• Sewing skills are not required. However, it is important that you can recognise fabrics and the different components of a garment.

Do you have experience in production or a technical background, and are you willing to work in shifts? Do you speak Dutch or English fluently?

• As a Production Worker, you will be responsible for making safety boots.

• Assembling components (steel toe cap, lining and steel sole) onto the mould

• Cleaning the machine

• After completing internal training, you will also be able to operate two other machines

• Experience as a production worker is required

• You are eager to learn and have a strong focus on quality

• You have your own means of transport

• You have a good command of Dutch or English

Responsibilities

• Analyze and translate business requirements and processes into detailed functional specifications for (Gen)AI topics.
• Design end-to-end solutions that are cost-efficient and meet specific customer needs.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver value through an iterative and MVP-driven approach.
• Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical profiles to ensure alignment on automation topics.
• Challenge requirements and specifications to ensure optimal solution design and rapid time-to-market.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in functional analysis for Generative AI implementations in corporate settings.
• 3+ years of experience with AWS and Azure AI technologies.
• 3+ years of experience with Python scripting.
• 3+ years of domain expertise within the energy sector.
• You have experience working with Agile and MVP methodologies.
• You possess strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
• You are fluent in English, French, and Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with process engineering or marketing automation.

jobs.occupation: UX Designer & Researcher – Figma & Design Thinking
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Lead UX research activities and manage the research repository to document user insights.
• Facilitate functional framing workshops, ideation sessions, and co-design activities with stakeholders and end-users.
• Collect user feedback and identify pain points through interviews, on-site observations, and user tests.
• Analyze user behavior and platform performance using tools like Matomo and heatmaps.
• Create wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and site maps to communicate interaction and design concepts.
• Collaborate with UI designers to ensure overall consistency with the established design system.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of experience in design thinking within agile project environments.
• You possess 5+ years of experience with qualitative and quantitative research methods.
• You bring 3+ years of experience in interaction design and information architecture.
• You're proficient in creating lo-fidelity wireframes and prototypes using Figma.
• You possess experience with analysis and collaboration tools such as Matomo, Miro, and PowerPoint.
• You hold a formal qualification or certification in UX.
• You possess a proactive and resilient attitude with strong facilitation and workshop management skills.
• You are fluent in English with a good level of Dutch and/or French.
Nice to Haves

• Ability to utilize design systems in Figma.
• Knowledge of the research tool Condens.
• Professional knowledge of German.

Responsibilities

• Design and build high-quality, well-tested software solutions within the transport execution domain.
• Translate business ideas into effective, reliable applications in collaboration with stakeholders.
• Develop secure and performant .NET Core Web APIs.
• Lead the development of complex native .NET for Android and Xamarin applications.
• Manage containerized deployments and set up Azure DevOps pipelines with Kubernetes and Docker.
• Ensure code craftsmanship by writing maintainable, SOLID code and automated unit tests.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in .NET development, demonstrating mastery of LINQ, async/await, and security practices.
• 5+ years of experience in cloud development leveraging Azure services, PaaS components, and event-driven patterns.
• 5+ years of experience developing native .NET for Android and Xamarin applications.
• 5+ years of experience building secure and performant .NET Core Web APIs.
• 2+ years of experience with Blazor development.
• Professional expertise in unit testing and test quality.
• Strong knowledge of SQL and relational database design and optimization.
• Practical experience with Git, Azure DevOps, Docker, and Kubernetes.
• You are professional, constructive, and remain calm in stressful situations.
• You are fluent in English with a C2 level.
Nice to Haves

• Willingness to actively contribute to team knowledge sharing and mentorship.

• Perform a variety of laboratory tests according to standard procedures 
 
• Work with pH meters, viscometers, colorimeters, spectrophotometers, ovens and incubators 
 
• Test enzyme activity in finished products 
 
• Sample incoming laboratory materials 
 
• Carry out wash tests on fabric samples 
 
• Collect water, air, equipment swab, environmental and raw-material samples 
 
• Prepare product batches for different departments 
 
• Calibrate equipment and replace Millipore filters 
 
• Register ICE tickets and maintain accurate laboratory data 
 
• Help improve procedures and workflows 
 
• Follow quality and safety procedures with care and consistency 

You have an A2 qualification in Sciences/Chemistry or relevant laboratory experience, and you are comfortable communicating in English.

Has an eye for detail
Takes quality seriously
Enjoys practical laboratory work
Is comfortable with Microsoft Office
Follows procedures while looking for opportunities to improve the way things are done

Responsibilities

• Define and implement comprehensive test strategies to ensure software reliability.
• Review business requirements and analysis documents to identify testing priorities.
• Design, execute, and manage complex test cases, scenarios, and plans.
• Automate test cases for APIs and UIs using specialized testing tools.
• Monitor defect lifecycles, resolve issues, and produce detailed quality reports.
• Assist project teams in estimating testing efforts and refining test deliverables.
• Drive continuous improvement of internal testing processes and quality assurance standards.

Requirements

• You bring 8+ years of professional experience in software testing, covering both manual and automated methodologies.
• You possess extensive expertise in defining test strategies and performing API testing.
• You have advanced knowledge of testing Java services, REST APIs, XML, XSD, and WSDL.
• You bring 5+ years of experience in analyzing and modelling complex business processes and workflows.
• You have hands-on experience with testing tools such as Playwright and ReadyAPI.
• You possess experience using Jira and Xray for test management and defect tracking.
• You have experience with Groovy Script or an equivalent scripting language for automation.
• You bring experience working within Agile development environments.
• You possess a Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field.
• You are fluent in English and either Dutch or French, with at least basic knowledge of the other national language (French or Dutch).
Nice to Haves

• Possession of an ISTQB certification.
• Familiarity with public administration systems or similar regulatory domains.
• Knowledge of OWASP security verification standards.

Responsibilities

• Identify stakeholders and analyse and challenge functional, non-functional, regulatory and security requirements.
• Define the scope, boundaries, assumptions and dependencies of the solution.
• Build a technical inventory and architecture roadmap covering legacy maintenance, platform modernisation and cybersecurity.
• Design the target architecture and compare scenarios on benefits, cost, risk, impact and reversibility.
• Record key decisions in Architecture Decision Records.
• Run gap analyses, propose transition stages and estimate implementation costs.
• Prepare architecture reviews and perform conformity reviews during delivery and before go-live.

Requirements

• You have 10+ years of experience with enterprise and solution architecture, governance and requirements management.
• You have 10+ years of experience as a solution architect on production systems, designing and integrating solutions across multiple technical domains and stakeholders.
• You master architecture modelling and produce coherent views across business, data, application and technology.
• You reason in scenarios, trade-offs, risks, dependencies, cost and value.
• You know integration patterns, APIs, data, infrastructure, cloud and cybersecurity, and understand operability, resilience, continuity, performance and lifecycle.
• You have experience with architecture reviews, risk analyses and guiding implementations.
• You have hands-on software development experience recent enough to be credible towards an engineering team.
• Practical knowledge of TOGAF is recommended; certification and knowledge of security practices and an ITSM framework are a plus.
• You are fluent in French and/or Dutch and English, spoken and written.

Oversee contractor-led tool installations for the Málaga cleanroom (Fab 5) project, with a focus on safety and conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines. 

 

What you will doFor the Málaga Fab 5 project, tool installations will be performed by the contractor. imec’s role focuses on safety oversight and validating that the installations conform to imec’s required standards and guidelines. That’s where you come in. Onboarding and training will take place in Leuven, Belgium until mid-2028, after which the position location will transfer to Málaga, Spain.  
As Project Lead, your role combines contractor oversight, safety follow-up and installation conformity validation on behalf of imec. 
The contractor is responsible for installation execution and day-to-day coordination of the installation works. You will monitor progress, review safety and quality matters, and coordinate interfaces with imec stakeholders, keeping a clear distinction between contractor execution and imec oversight. 
Your focus is to validate conformity with imec’s installation standards, guidelines and safety requirements. You will review contractor deliverables and installation evidence, follow up deviations and corrective actions, and support installation acceptance by imec rather than directly managing execution. 
You will: 
 
 

• Oversee contractor-led installations and coordinate interfaces with imec 

• Review contractor schedules and monitor progress against agreed milestones 

• Flag scope deviations and their impact on timelines, budgets and priorities 

• Validate installation conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines through reviews, inspections and supporting records 

• Provide safety oversight and follow up contractor actions on safety and quality findings 

• Keep internal stakeholders and external partners informed 

• Escalate risks and non-conformities, track corrective actions and review evidence for installation acceptance 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electromechanical Engineering.  

• You have at least 5 years of relevant technical experience.  

• You have experience overseeing contractor-led technical projects and reviewing installations against defined standards and guidelines.  

• You communicate openly and proactively with both internal customers and external partners about the status of ongoing work, and you escalate issues promptly when needed.  

• You adapt easily to changes and time pressure and combine a practical mindset with a strong focus on safety, quality and conformity.  

• You are fluent in English and Spanish.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with business analysts and software developers for our equipment integration solution. You will be supported by dedicated test engineers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You perform the crucial task of analyzing how our equipment integration software platform can implement business requirements. The specifications to be passed on to internal and more often external developers can range from straightforward configuration to additional logic to be defined. 

• Some business requirements will result in equipment integration being dependent on related configuration or even features to be implemented in adjacent applications, especially the MES. You thus will gain sufficient knowledge about adjacent CIM applications to effectively collaborate with their business analysts and functional analysts. 

• You have an active role in test preparation and debugging. You will be supported by our PMO team during all phases of the software lifecycle. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience. 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You have participated in a CIM project, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. 

• You have strong analytical skills and are solution oriented. You can challenge assumptions and question approaches. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are dependable. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment. 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with equipment engineers and software developers.  

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial task will be the verification of equipment to host communication as specified during purchasing. Semiconductor equipment communication follows a comprehensive set of standards. However, these standards allow for differences in implementation and scope definition which often cause complications with equipment integration.  

• Once more experienced, you will play a decisive role in exploring equipment behavior at the communication interfaces under different operational scenarios.  

• Your test results are not just necessary for bug fixing. They are crucial input for equipment integration developers in the first place.  

• You will contribute to improving our test methodology, utilizing dedicated test software as well as equipment simulators. 

Who you are
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development and testing, specifically related to hardware automation.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You did apply concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. You understand the difference between instructions and reports. You know how to analyze data exchange with hardware units and debug communication issues.  

• You have strong analytical skills, are self-critical, and solution oriented.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

You will be a member of the Defect Inspection Engineer team (DIE) which is part of the Inspection and Metrology Characterization group (IMC). The IMC group is responsible for the metrology and defectivity process portfolio and tools and follows up processes under evaluation/validation for furture needs. As process engineer in the DIE team, you will be responsible for tools and processes:
 
 

• Process & tool qualification, monitor stability, implement improvements for improved quality and cycle time. 

• Troubleshooting defectivity related issues reported by the First Line Support which cannot be resolved by themselves. 

• Analyze data utilizing sound statistical methods and present summaries to peers and management. 

• Fulfill requests for new applications and create the tool recipes. 

• Investigate tool and recipe issues, focus on root cause analysis and development of long-term solutions. 

• Utilizing expert interpersonal skills, collaborate in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts. 

• As opportunities arise, innovate new techniques of characterization that align with the Imec’s technology roadmap. 

• You will work in two shifts (early/late) including one weekend out of four (Sa/Su), to support the 24h by 7d fab. 

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or Engineering or equal by experience and display strong engineering skills and mindset. 

• Experience in a FAB environment is a strong asset. 

• You are data driven and seek out information before making decisions and taking action. 

• You like to work autonomously, well organized, with good attention to detail and set high standards for quality. 

• You speak fluent English. 

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required. You are a team player with strong drive to share your expertise and knowledge with colleagues. You strive to document and report.
